subtitle: 목숨 구해준 드루를 물탐 중 버리고 퀘몹만 잡다 같이 누운 흑마

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
강물터에서 흑마 뒤치기냐!
저리 꺼져, 얍삽한 도적!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dynamic ambush-block shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal riverbank grass and pebbles touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, heroic Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) leaps forward fiercely with raised empty hands and bright emerald swipe arcs intercepting a surprise attack. On the right, startled Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) springs backward into a swirling puff of stealth smoke with wide surprised blue eyes.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:

On the left, sighing Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) sits cross-legged sipping from an uncorked open-necked translucent blue glass mana flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the grass beside her, lingering green heal sparkles fading as her cow-hood ears droop in disappointment. cuts.dialogue:

cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder ambush shot from behind sitting Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back, holding an uncorked open-necked translucent blue glass mana flask with the wooden cork visibly removed on the grass beside her in lower-left foreground) looking at Gnome Rogue appearing right behind her on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-left space and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. equip_effects: 그림자 속에 숨어 적의 눈에 띄지 않게 됩니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 83 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. Battered Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed away, comic band-aid on her plush brown cow hood and dizzy impact stars floating nearby) stares sideways with wide teary hollow eyes of sheer betrayal and trembling lips as jagged pale shock lines radiate behind her.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
야 나 옆에서 맞고 있잖아!
눈앞에서 퀘몹만 잡냐?!
